IMAGE1 is EDIT TARGET: newly drawn correct five-card character sprite. Repaint ONE independent animation pose cast/E/07. Camera-far anatomical LEFT hand grips bronze bell/red tassel, behind torso to SCREEN LEFT. Exactly TWO arms, TWO shoulders, TWO sleeve openings, TWO hands. Each sleeve continuously connects shoulder to wrist and hand, absolutely no extra cuff or empty sleeve at waist/chest. Both grips readable.
NEW POSE: Mid-release BEFORE the target peak: near RIGHT elbow bends about30degrees, retracting the unchanged FIVE-card fan about6% canvas toward body and raising it1% canvas, palm clearly grips all five bases. Far LEFT bell remains raised behind torso on screen-left, elbow at shoulder height and no third sleeve. Body leans slightly forward, front knee bent, rear foot planted, stance a little less extended than target; head pixels unchanged. Mouth slightly open, gaze RIGHT. Exactly two continuous sleeve tubes, no loose empty cuff.
Maintain chestnut high ponytail, red jewel gold crown, short red/gold flame robe, black pants, yin-yang waist ornament and red-black-gold shoes. Fixed virtual root x512/ground y920 at1024; preserve target whole-canvas composition and exact body-part pixel scales. Single native square frame at least1024, true transparent RGBA. No ground, baked shadow, background, labels, effects, aura, detached flame or particles. Not a sheet.
